Hi Dana —

Thanks again for the productive call earlier. Attached is MAP_v3 with the evaluation milestones we discussed and a recommended commercial structure to match: short pilot (30 days) -> phased ramp to committed throughput (Q4 start). Highlights: 

- Evaluation plan: 30-day technical pilot with two Milestones:
  1) Integration + latency validation (week 1–2)
  2) Quality & embedding accuracy review + 5k sample queries (week 3–4)
- Commercial ask: 12-month commitment starting after pilot: initial commit of 200k tokens/month, ramp to 1M tokens/month by month 4
- Pricing: list price shown in pricing_sheet_polaris.xlsx; Polaris asked for an introductory discount tied to milestone acceptance.

Specifically Polaris is asking for: a 30% discount for the first 3 months in exchange for the 12-month commit and a published case study. I know that is outside standard playbook, so looping in Marissa and Ben for approval path.

Attachments: Polaris_MAP_v3.pdf (MAP), pricing_sheet_polaris.xlsx (line-item pricing), PO_Request_Form.pdf (procurement).

As next steps: 
- Dana: confirm the pilot start date you want (we had been targeting week of Aug 9)
- Marissa/Ben: can you advise the approval route for a promo-level discount? VP/CFO/CEO sign-off likely required. If we can get preliminary OK this week we can include it in Polaris' contracting timeline.

Thanks,

Karthik Iyer

Team —

Forwarding Polaris' confirmation and procurement note. They need an explicit email confirmation of the promotional discount (30% off months 1–3) to get the PO moving. Deal context: strategic healthcare customer, potential to expand to 6 elevated units across regions in year 2. Committed 12-month term after pilot, ramp to 1M tokens/mo.

Proposal I'm asking you to consider:
- Approve 30% off list for months 1–3 (applied to token usage up to initial commit).
- In exchange: Polaris signs the 12-month commitment (with ramp schedule) and grants Redwood permission to publish a joint case study after Q2 2028.

If we need an alternative, I can propose a staged discount: 20% month 1, 25% month 2, 30% month 3 but preference is to keep it simple to unblock procurement.

Can you confirm route for VP/CFO/CEO sign-off? If we get verbal nod here, I'll capture in formal redline.

Thanks,
Karthik

Karthik — please send the formal confirmation to Dana and procurement with the conditions and attach the approved memo and pricing_sheet_polaris.xlsx. Ben/Marissa — thanks for moving quickly on this.
